title: stv-watch event line
description: One line of `stv-watch --json` output and of a session's events.jsonl. Field order is as listed: t_utc, t_local (only with --tz), type, steamid64, nick, text, then the extra fields of the type. Which extra fields each type carries is listed in docs/session-files.md; a type never carries the extras of another.

t_utc.description: UTC time of the event: receive time of the packet that carried it, millisecond precision. For the first `play` line and lines written before any traffic, the wall clock.

t_local.description: The same moment in the --tz zone, to the second, without an offset. Present only when --tz was given.

type.description: Game events: chat, console, connect, join, leave, death, team, name, server, sourcemod (filtered by --events). The viewer's own lines: conn (connection), net (traffic), play (replay), tvd (network client log), done (exit).

steamid64.description: SteamID64 of the player the line is about (the killer for a death), 0 when unknown or not a player.

nick.description: The player's nick as the stream names him; 'Console' for console lines; empty when none.

text.description: What happened, as text. For chat: what was said.

channel.description: chat: all, team, alldead, teamdead, allspec, plugin (a plugin formatted the line), saytext (SayText from a player).

ent.description: chat: entity index of the speaker.

userid.description: connect, leave, death, team, name: server userid of the player (the victim for a death).

networkid.description: leave: the network id as the server reports it (SteamID text or BOT).

bot.description: leave: the player was a bot.

attacker.description: death: server userid of the attacker, 0 for the world.

victim.description: death by another player: the victim's nick.

victim_steamid64.description: death by another player: the victim's SteamID64, 0 when unknown.

team.description: team: new team number (0 unassigned, 1 spectator, 2 combine, 3 rebels).

via.description: server, sourcemod: the message that carried the text (TextMsg, HudMsg, SayText2, server_cvar).

dest.description: server via TextMsg: HUD destination code.

cvar.description: server via server_cvar: the console variable.

value.description: server via server_cvar: its new value.

seq_from.description: net, --debug only: highest sequence number before the gap.

seq_to.description: net, --debug only: sequence number after the gap.

lost.description: net, --debug only: sequence numbers lost in the gap (not declared choked).
